review.notes: Fence inventory is balanced (31 three-backtick pairs); the printed prompt boxes are transcribed as fenced blocks, including the MMMU-Pro template whose literal '## Step 1:' lines stay inside the fence. Full window diff of all 26 pages against the OCR Markdown; every unmatched window was inspected and classified. All table captions (Tables 1-15), figure captions, the references (pages 15-18) and appendix prompt content are present; spot-checked table bodies (Table 10 WER 8.4/4.3/35.9, Table 13 TTFA 0.98/0.63/1.39, Table 14 Claude Sonnet 4.5 row) match the extraction. Remaining unmatched windows are figure-internal chart labels, PDF-side URL line breaks, and apostrophe glyphs missing from the PDF text layer (print 'arent' vs OCR "aren't") that the OCR transcribed correctly. Pages 2, 4, 6, 9, 11, 12, 19, 20, 21 were rendered and visually verified. All nine page-bottom footnotes were dropped by OCR; markers $^{1}$-$^{9}$ survive (footnote 2 as $^2$) and the bodies are restored after the paragraphs carrying the markers. The source itself prints 'https://artificialanalysis.ai/ tested on 26 November, 2025.' with a space after the slash (verified at 300 dpi); transcribed verbatim.
